events.name: issued_inst
events.desc: Instructions issued, including speculative work later squashed

events.name: stall_frontend
events.desc: Cycles stalled waiting on the frontend (fetch redirect, instruction cache, branch resteer)

events.name: stall_backend
events.desc: Cycles stalled waiting on the backend (memory, execution latency, dependencies)

events.name: store_inst
events.desc: Scalar store instructions retired, including AMO and SC

events.name: vector_inst
events.desc: Vector arithmetic instructions retired, excluding vector loads and stores

events.name: fence_inst
events.desc: Fence and LR/SC synchronization instructions retired

events.name: br_inst_spec
events.desc: Branch instructions executed, including speculative wrong-path branches

events.name: l2_access
events.desc: L2 cache accesses, including page-table walks

events.name: l2_miss
events.desc: L2 cache misses served from memory

events.name: dtlb_read_miss
events.desc: Data TLB read misses causing a page-table walk

events.name: dtlb_write_miss
events.desc: Data TLB write misses causing a page-table walk

events.name: itlb_read_miss
events.desc: Instruction TLB misses causing a page-table walk

metrics.name: IPC
metrics.desc: Instructions retired per cycle

metrics.name: branch_mispredict_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of retired branches that were mispredicted

metrics.name: speculation_waste
metrics.desc: Fraction of issued instructions that never retired

metrics.name: l1d_miss_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of L1 data cache reads that missed

metrics.name: l1i_miss_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of L1 instruction cache reads that missed

metrics.name: l2_miss_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of L2 accesses served from memory

metrics.name: dtlb_miss_rate
metrics.desc: Fraction of data TLB reads that caused a page-table walk

metrics.name: memory_inst_share
metrics.desc: Fraction of retired instructions that access memory

metrics.name: retiring
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by instructions that retired

metrics.name: bad_speculation
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by instructions that never retired
metrics.formula: min(max(0, 1 - retiring), max(0, issued_inst - instructions) / ($pipeline_width * cycles))

metrics.name: fe_bound
metrics.desc: Issue slots lost because the frontend did not supply the backend
metrics.formula: max(0, 1 - retiring - bad_speculation) * stall_frontend / max(1, stall_frontend + stall_backend)

metrics.name: be_bound
metrics.desc: Issue slots lost because the backend could not accept more work
metrics.formula: max(0, 1 - retiring - bad_speculation) * stall_backend / max(1, stall_frontend + stall_backend)

metrics.name: fe_bound.branch_resteer
metrics.desc: Frontend stalls refetching after a mispredicted branch

metrics.name: fe_bound.latency
metrics.desc: Frontend stalls attributable to instruction cache and ITLB misses

metrics.name: fe_bound.bandwidth
metrics.desc: Frontend stalls from fetch and decode throughput rather than misses

metrics.name: bad_speculation.branch_mispredict
metrics.desc: Bad speculation caused by mispredicted branches

metrics.name: bad_speculation.other
metrics.desc: Bad speculation from pipeline flushes other than branch mispredicts

metrics.name: be_bound.memory_bound
metrics.desc: Backend stalls attributable to the memory hierarchy
metrics.formula: min(be_bound, (max(0, l1d_read_miss - l2_miss) * $l2_hit_latency + l2_miss * $dram_latency + dtlb_read_miss * $page_walk_latency) / cycles)

metrics.name: be_bound.core_bound
metrics.desc: Backend stalls from execution latency and dependencies rather than memory

metrics.name: be_bound.memory_bound.l2_bound
metrics.desc: Memory stalls served by the L2 cache
metrics.formula: be_bound.memory_bound * (max(0, l1d_read_miss - l2_miss) * $l2_hit_latency) / max(1, max(0, l1d_read_miss - l2_miss) * $l2_hit_latency + l2_miss * $dram_latency + dtlb_read_miss * $page_walk_latency)

metrics.name: be_bound.memory_bound.dram_bound
metrics.desc: Memory stalls served from DRAM
metrics.formula: be_bound.memory_bound * (l2_miss * $dram_latency) / max(1, max(0, l1d_read_miss - l2_miss) * $l2_hit_latency + l2_miss * $dram_latency + dtlb_read_miss * $page_walk_latency)

metrics.name: be_bound.memory_bound.dtlb_bound
metrics.desc: Memory stalls caused by data page-table walks
metrics.formula: be_bound.memory_bound * (dtlb_read_miss * $page_walk_latency) / max(1, max(0, l1d_read_miss - l2_miss) * $l2_hit_latency + l2_miss * $dram_latency + dtlb_read_miss * $page_walk_latency)

metrics.name: retiring.vector
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by retired vector arithmetic

metrics.name: retiring.fp
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by retired scalar floating-point instructions

metrics.name: retiring.memory
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by retired loads and stores

metrics.name: retiring.other
metrics.desc: Issue slots used by other retired instructions
